notes.title: Update 1.1 of Ante Mortem : Content & Compas
notes.content:
[h1][b][i][u]Major Additions :[/u][/i][/b][/h1] 

[h2]Zones :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Abandonned Pool
[*] Church
[*] Satanic Zone
[*] Cemetery 
[*] ???
[/list]

[h2]Features :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Compass
[*] Cursor
[*] Optional quest (Church)
[*] More horror elements...
[/list]

[h1][i][u][b]Minor Additions :[/b][/u][/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] Text of the menus which remained in English for the french users. 
[*] Changed texture type for all invisible collision areas.
[*] Changed location of some sounds
[*] Pause when Window or Alt button is pressed (to imitate unfocus)
[*] A few plants (grass, flowers etc.) and trees less to optimize the game.
[*] Added new commands in the "Tuto" text at the top left of the pause menu.
[/list]

[h1][i][u][b]Bugs & Crashs :[/b][/u][/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] Aircraft lights flashing
[*] Offset the height of the TP Undermap area to put it a little higher.
[*] Crash after a while for no reason which was actually due to some sounds not clearing their cache.(Thanks [i][b]Ttkiti[/b][/i] for you precious help ːsteamthumbsupː )
[*] 8 more minor bugs resolved...
[/list]

[i][h3]Thanks Josh (Leadwerks Creator) because I use few 3D elements to have this new update fastly.
[/h3][/i]

[previewyoutube=Qu9uuIJwipo;full][/previewyoutube]
